crossRefs.note: Woe to Ariel! Ariel, the city where David encamped! Add year to year; let the feasts come around;
then I will distress Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation. She shall be to me as an altar hearth.

Yahweh is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.

translations.web: The upper altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar hearth and upward there shall be four horns.
translations.bsb: The altar hearth shall be four cubits high, and four horns shall project upward from the hearth.
translations.kjv: So the altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar and upward shall be four horns.
translations.asv: And the upper altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar hearth and upward there shall be four horns.
